actions.label: Add prompt.text from Node Library
actions.expected: The blank document creates prompt.text through the canonical registry.

actions.label: Add generation.image from Node Library
actions.expected: The blank document creates generation.image through the canonical registry.

actions.label: Select source Prompt
actions.expected: The blank document's source prompt becomes the direct canvas editing target.

actions.label: Edit source Prompt
actions.expected: The ordinary Prompt editor opens on the canvas.

actions.label: Commit source Prompt
actions.expected: The reusable source-artifact brief is saved as authored graph content.

actions.label: Select source Image Generator
actions.expected: The ordinary Inspector exposes the recovery-only fake image profile.

actions.label: Save source Image Generator fake profile
actions.expected: The durable binding is the explicit local simulation profile, not a real-provider fallback.

actions.label: Begin source Prompt to Image Generator
actions.expected: The compatible Text input handle becomes the intended receiver.

actions.label: Complete source Prompt to Image Generator
actions.expected: The exact visible lane persists through ordinary channel interaction.

actions.label: Select source Image Generator
actions.expected: The explicit local recovery image route is prepared from the blank graph.

actions.label: Preview source artifact plan
actions.expected: The one-call fake image plan is inspected before a permit is issued.

actions.label: Start source artifact plan
actions.expected: Only the reviewed offline fake image plan starts; no real provider is contacted.

actions.label: Wait for the source artifact to become durable
actions.expected: Job Center exposes the durable transition created through the reviewed recipe plan.

actions.label: Return to Build after source artifact
actions.expected: The completed current-document artifact is available to recipe setup without changing the graph.

actions.label: Inspect source artifact output
actions.expected: The generated source is confirmed on its ordinary Image Generator node.

actions.label: Open Reference Description to Prompt in Recipe Gallery
actions.expected: The blank document reaches its built-in recipes through the ordinary Gallery command.

actions.label: Choose Reference Description to Prompt
actions.expected: The versioned built-in recipe loads its real setup sheet and token-scoped fake-provider readiness through the application boundary.

actions.label: Preview Reference Description to Prompt
actions.expected: The Gallery validates the current document artifact, exact call range, and token-scoped fake-provider substitutions before insertion.

actions.label: Insert Reference Description to Prompt
actions.expected: The Gallery inserts the prepared built-in graph as one undoable ordinary UI transaction without starting provider work.

actions.label: Fit inserted recipe
actions.expected: The inserted recipe's cards and visible lanes fit the ordinary canvas viewport.

actions.label: Select Reference Description to Prompt run root
actions.expected: The recipe's advertised run node is selected through its visible keyboard-focusable title even when a connection lane crosses the card.

actions.label: Preview Reference Description to Prompt Branch
actions.expected: The exact recipe boundary, fake-provider bindings, and call count are visible before permission is granted.

actions.label: Start Reference Description to Prompt reviewed plan
actions.expected: Only this immutable fake-provider recipe plan receives a one-use permit and starts.

actions.label: Wait for the advertised fake Worker output
actions.expected: Job Center exposes the durable transition created through the reviewed recipe plan.

actions.label: Inspect Reference Description to Prompt output
actions.expected: The recipe returns to its visible canvas with the fake-provider output persisted.

actions.label: Select Reference Description to Prompt output node
actions.expected: The advertised fake-provider output is inspected on the inserted recipe itself.

actions.label: Capture Reference Description to Prompt fake-provider output
actions.expected: This fresh-document recipe was configured, inserted, explicitly previewed, permitted, and completed through ordinary controls using only the recovery simulation.
actions.actual: Captured after the documented preceding action.

actions.label: Reference Description to Prompt packaged recipe
actions.expected: The built-in workflow reaches its advertised fake-provider output from a fresh document through visible setup and run controls.
actions.actual: The journey inserted 3 recipe nodes after visibly generating and selecting a real current-document source artifact, reviewed an immutable 1-call plan, and completed the durable result without any real provider.
